Lizol is India's No.1 Household Cleaning Brand, highly recommended by the Indian Medical Association. Lizol guarantees to kill 99.99% of disease-causing bacteria as well as germs while leaving your room smelling fragrant with a wide variety of aromas. Suitable for household with pets.^
This cleaner removes 100 types of Stains & Germs and leaves a Pleasant Fragrance. Available Variants are Pine, Floral, Citrus, Jasmine, Lavender, Sandal and Neem in the sizes: 200 ml, 500 ml, 1L, 1.8L Refill, 2L and 5L.
details.usageInstructions:
Floor and Bathroom Surfaces: 
Use 16ml (one capful) in half a bucket of water (4 Litres).
Gently mop on Surface. No need to rinse.
 Kitchen Surfaces: 
For tough stains, use undiluted. Apply on the dirty surface.
Leave for 5 minutes and then rinse well with water immediately.
Neat use is recommended on polished marble, granite and ceramic tiles only.

title: Shakti Disinfectant Floor Cleaner - Aqua Fresh with Pine Oil

details.description: Elevate your home's cleanliness and hygiene with Lizol Shakti Disinfectant Floor Cleaner Aqua Fresh. This superior-quality product is designed to eliminate 99.9% of harmful germs, leaving behind a refreshing aqua fresh scent that invigorates your living spaces. Formulated with pine oil, this powerful cleaner not only removes stubborn stains but also provides a protective layer against bacteria and viruses. Suitable for use on a variety of surfaces, including tiles, marble, and wooden floors, Lizol Shakti delivers a sparkling, residue-free shine that will delight your senses. Enjoy a pleasant cleaning experience and a fresh, inviting atmosphere with this all-purpose floor cleaner.
details.usageInstructions:
Shake well before use. For everyday floor and bathroom cleaning: Dilute the product with water as 1:250. Gently mop the surface. No need to rinse.
For Disinfection: Dilute the product with water as 1:30.
Gently mop the surface. No need to rinse.
For tough stains: Use undiluted, leave for 5 mins and then rinse well with water.
To Kill Fungi: Use undiluted and apply to pre-cleaned surface, let surface remain wet for 30 mins and rinse well with water. Neat usage is recommended on polished marble, granite and ceramic tiles only. Appearance may vary over the period of shelf life but no impact on product efficacy. Store in cool, dry place and away from direct sunlight.

details.description: Lizol Power Bathroom Cleaner Triggers remove 99.9% of germs and eliminates staph and salmonella bacteria on hard non-porous surfaces. Also, it can be used on a variety of household surfaces, including Shower Doors, Tubs, Glazed ceramic tiles, Vanity tops, Sinks, Chrome fixtures, etc. It removes soap scum, limescale and has a clean, fresh scent.

Lizol Floral Fresh & Clean Bathroom Cleaner Liquid is specially formulated to effectively clean bathroom surfaces while leaving a pleasant floral fragrance. Its powerful formula removes dirt, grime, and soap scum, leaving surfaces looking spotless and feeling fresh. Suitable for regular use, it helps keep your bathroom hygienic and inviting.
details.usageInstructions:
Avoid direct contact with the skin and wear gloves, especially when using the product undiluted.
For disinfection and tough stain removal on bathroom floors, tiles, and sinks: Use neat. Pour the product directly onto the surface, spread it evenly, and leave for 5 minutes. Scrub the surface, then rinse thoroughly.
For regular cleaning of bathroom floors and tiles: Add 1.5 capfuls of the product to a mug of water (approximately 0.5?L) and mix well. Pour onto the surface, scrub, and rinse.
Always read the label on the pack before use. If concerned, test on a small, inconspicuous area first.
Always use diluted product on marble floors and bathroom fixtures.
